reuse.why: All providers use the shared link preparation and bank lookup helpers, unlinking shares clearLocalBankLink, and Akahu and Fintegra share transaction downloading.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds copies of the existing account-link orchestration, status request, and account-list request despite sharing validation and transaction downloading.

placement.why: Link policies and local unlinking live in accounts/link.ts, while handlers, downloading, configuration, and model types follow the existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The changes address the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration, although the additional status and account-list endpoints extend beyond the specified API.

maintainability.why: The shared policies provide consistent extension points, but another substantial provider-link copy increases the maintenance burden for future workflow changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers call prepareBankAccountLink and findOrCreateBank, and both unlink paths use clearLocalBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated Fintegra link, status, and account-list implementations are straightforward provider substitutions rather than reshaped logic.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gains the replaceExistingLink flag and branches for closed-target rejection and opt-in link replacement; every provider continues through the shared helper.
